allegation_summary: On July 4, 2025, LATAM Airlines sent a gaslighting email to passenger [[SPK-passenger-leandro]] via Christopher Calle (Customer Service). The email stated: 'verificamos que no fueran encontrados impedimentos en nuestros sistemas de modo que usted puede realizar la compra de boletos aéreos' — this was knowingly false, as LATAM had imposed a lifetime ban on July 5, 2024 and enforced it on July 6, 2024. The email refused to provide documentation, CCTV recordings, or evidence, stating these could 'only be delivered upon formal request from competent authority' — despite the passenger having already filed formal complaints with Carabineros. The timing — one year later, after the passenger began going public on LinkedIn — reveals a strategic gaslighting maneuver designed to publicly discredit the passenger's claims.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Obligación de respetar los términos y condiciones ofrecidos o convenidos
